name: Ojiya (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ojiya city emblem in white and maroon: a white cog-like ring enclosing a maroon disc with white strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ojiya, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 11 August 1984; the emblem dates from 11 August 1954.

features.role: Ojiya city emblem — a white cog-like ring enclosing a maroon disc with white strokes
